description: The two specified unions of residue classes modulo four form an independent pair; their four Boolean cells are exactly the four residue classes.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.four_residue_example :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.IsIndependent
      {Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueA, Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueB} ∧
    Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueA ∩ Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueB =
        {n | ∃ k, n = 4 * k} ∧
      Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueA \ Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueB =
          {n | ∃ k, n = 4 * k + 1} ∧
        Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueB \ Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueA =
            {n | ∃ k, n = 4 * k + 2} ∧
          (Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueA ∪ Lemmatheca.Entry.IndependentFamilies.residueB)ᶜ =
            {n | ∃ k, n = 4 * k + 3}
